verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows in Sentry. Alerts and Seer Autofix are event-triggered: they act when issues arrive or match rules, not on a recurring schedule. The mention of alerts 'coming from projects or Monitors' concerns monitoring, not running scheduled jobs, so it is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
